content_note: One hundred species lines (Wildloom): identity, stage names, habitat — no catalog-level combat typing. primary_affinity / secondary_affinity are null here; each creature instance rolls none / one / two dominant affinities plus emphasis vector (TECHNICAL-DESIGN §1). Stage name prefixes still draw flavor words from affinity-themed pools for lore-only variety.
